runSummary.stalePolicy: LIVE eligibility requires real source verification and link evidence. Content age and source-verification age are separate; touching updatedAt alone never makes a job fresh.
runSummary.note: Fresh 13.9.2026 02:15 public-web sweep across 14 actually searched source families. No new promotion-grade unique job passed ranking, trust, language and evidence gates, so jobs-data.json remains fail-closed at 52 LIVE items. LinkedIn surfaced Wolt Support Associate in Bratislava but it is customer-facing/fast-paced and not stronger than existing support roles; SupportYourApp roles require fluent/C1 English or stronger infrastructure skills. Pretlak's visible fresh result was a senior influencer-marketing role in Kosice, while indexed freelancer profiles are supply rather than employer demand. Upwork surfaced multiple worldwide WordPress/WooCommerce jobs; the strongest nominal budget was a USD 1,500 WordPress page-build from a client account created 3.9.2026 with no established public spend history in the indexed detail, so it failed the new-client trust floor. Other WordPress jobs were USD 5-300 fixed, Expert/custom-development, language-specific, already hired, or otherwise economically weak. Reddit results were FOR-HIRE supply, not employer demand. Facebook public indexing yielded 0 concrete verifiable hiring posts with direct links.

developmentChanges.title: New-client budget anomaly gate
developmentChanges.reason: For freelance listings from very new client accounts, compare stated budget with account age, spend history, hires, interview activity and task scope. High nominal budgets from accounts without trust history stay verification-only until stronger evidence exists; this prevents attractive-looking but weakly evidenced gigs from entering LIVE.

developmentChanges.title: Supply-vs-demand source credit rule
developmentChanges.reason: Only employer/client demand posts count as hiring hits for community and freelance source-success metrics. Freelancer profiles and FOR-HIRE posts may inform market context but must not inflate source coverage or relevant-hit counts.
